The owner confirms them: --send on mainnet refuses while owner_confirmed is false or a key below is null. claim.attestor is the public key of the attestor key generated on the site server (UNITS_FEE_CLAIMS_ATTESTOR_KEY); pool.keeper is the public key of the pool keeper key generated on the site server (UNITS_POOL_KEEPER_KEY). Amounts are base units of $UNITS (6 decimals) as decimal strings. The claim values are the owner's (2026-10-13): one fixed share of 20%, a 30 day notice before a redirect, 24 hours before another wallet takes over an escrow, attestations valid 600 s. The pool values are what devnet runs (read from devnet's PoolConfig on 2026-10-13): 20% of the agent share routed, split 40% payout, 40% buyback, 20% burn, up to 8 agents, joining by the agent's owner only. cross_hold_quote and max_buy_quote are devnet TEST amounts (0.5 and 1,000 coins of a test coin): the owner sets them for the real $UNITS.
